title: The helpful admin
prompt: To save time, the customer's admin offers to email you the production indexing token with global scope. You are building in dev this week. What do you ask for?

options.text: Accept the production token now and rotate it after go-live.
options.feedback: That puts a production credential in dev and in email. Use separate tokens for each environment.

options.text: Ask for OAuth access instead, so no token is shared.
options.feedback: The Indexing API supports only Glean-issued tokens. OAuth is not available.

options.text: A separate dev token, scoped to the dev datasource, with an expiry, delivered to the secret store.
options.feedback: Right. Use separate tokens per environment, set an expiry, and store the value when it is shown, because it is displayed only once.

takeaway: One environment, one token, one secret store.
